sourceText:
Light Parmesan Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 12:25am

Ingredients




1/2 cup Parmesan cheese
1/4 cup dry bread crumbs
1 teaspoon dried oregano
1 teaspoon parsley flakes
1/4 paprika
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper
6 skinless boneless chicken breast
Butter Flavored Cooking Spray
Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

Preparation

1 Spray a large baking dish with non-stick cooking spray. In a shallow dish, mix cheese, bread crumbs, parsley, oregano, paprika and salt and pepper. Spray chicken with butter flavored spray, coat with crumb mixture. Place the coated chicken in the baking pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through.
